title: SmartHome Hub
problem_statement: Smart home technology is becoming increasingly popular but many products don't work well together. Homeowners want a unified solution to control all their smart home devices from one place. SmartHome Hub will be a central controller that connects all smart home devices and provides a simple, unified interface for managing the whole home.
target_users: Homeowners interested in smart home technology
Tech-savvy consumers who want home automation
People who want to make their home more convenient and efficient
user_stories: As a homeowner, I want to control all my smart devices from one app so that I don't need to switch between multiple apps
As a user, I want to set up automations so that my home does things automatically based on my preferences
As a homeowner, I want to monitor my energy usage so that I can potentially save money on utilities
As a user, I want voice control for my smart home so that I can use hands-free commands
acceptance_criteria: The hub should connect and work with major smart home brands
The app should provide a simple and intuitive interface for device control
Automations should work reliably most of the time
The system should be secure and protect user privacy appropriately

success_metrics.metric: Hub units sold in first year
success_metrics.target: Strong sales performance in the first year

success_metrics.baseline: Initial set of supported devices at launch

risks_open_questions: Competition from Google Home, Amazon Echo, and Apple HomeKit is very strong
Device compatibility challenges with the wide range of smart home products available
Security and privacy concerns with always-on connected home devices
out_of_scope: Features planned for future hardware generations
